## Why

Two rough edges surfaced from hands-on use: the app had no home-screen icon, and the primary/secondary
buttons that hug their content (the finished-screen "Done", the empty-list "Create your first workout",
the save-failed "Retry") rendered taller-than-wide with text jammed to the edges. Both are quick,
visual fixes that make the app feel finished.

## What Changes

- **App icon** (DESIGN §10): add the "Ring + PR" mark — a red timer-ring arc around a bold off-white
  "PR" on a near-black field — as an `AppIcon.appiconset`, generated by a committed, reproducible
  SwiftUI renderer (`scripts/gen-icon.swift`) and wired via `ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME`.
  (Designed in Open Design; DESIGN.md §10 is its source of truth — no OpenSpec capability covers it.)
- **Button horizontal padding**: the primary and secondary button styles gain internal horizontal
  padding, so a hug-content (`fixedSize`) button has breathing room instead of a cramped, narrow pill.
  Full-width buttons are unaffected.

## Capabilities

### Modified Capabilities
- `design-components`: the button styles now include internal horizontal padding so hug-content
  buttons aren't cramped.

## Impact

- `Sources/ProRoundsDesignSystem/Buttons.swift` (padding on primary + secondary styles) — re-record the
  affected snapshots (design-system buttons, the config empty state, the workout finished / save-failed
  screens).
- New: `scripts/gen-icon.swift`, `ProRounds/Assets.xcassets/AppIcon.appiconset/`, `project.yml`
  (`ASSETCATALOG_COMPILER_APPICON_NAME`). The icon PNG has an alpha channel (fine for dev; flatten
  before App Store submission).
- No behavior/logic change, no new dependencies.
